errorPage.title: This admin page couldn't load
errorPage.description: Something went wrong while loading the data. Please try again; if it keeps happening, tell the tech team.

scam.label: Scam or fraud
scam.explanation: Your account was used in a way that looks like a scam, such as fake offers or attempts to take money from other users.

fake_listings.label: Fake or misleading listings
fake_listings.explanation: Your listings show properties, photos or prices that are not real or do not match the actual place.

asked_money_upfront.label: Asking for money before a viewing
asked_money_upfront.explanation: Users reported that you asked for a deposit or payment before they could see the property. This is not allowed on our site.

spam.label: Spam
spam.explanation: Your account posted repeated, irrelevant or promotional content.

abusive_behavior.label: Abusive behavior
abusive_behavior.explanation: Users reported rude, threatening or harassing messages from your account.

impersonation.label: Pretending to be someone else
impersonation.explanation: Your account uses a name, photo or business details that belong to another person or company.

discrimination.label: Discrimination
discrimination.explanation: Your listings or messages limit who may rent or buy. Every person must be treated equally.

multiple_accounts.label: Several accounts
multiple_accounts.explanation: You use more than one account in a way that breaks our rules, for example to get around a limit or a block.

rules_violation.label: Breaking the site rules
rules_violation.explanation: Your account broke the rules of our site. Please read them again carefully.

other.label: Other
other.explanation: Please read the note from our team below.

document_unreadable.label: The document can't be read
document_unreadable.explanation: The photo or scan is blurry, too dark or cut off. Please send a clear photo where every detail can be read.

document_expired.label: The document has expired
document_expired.explanation: The document you sent is no longer valid. Please send a valid document.

document_incomplete.label: Something is missing
document_incomplete.explanation: Some pages or sides of the document are missing. Please send the complete document.

wrong_document.label: Wrong type of document
wrong_document.explanation: This document can't be used for this check. Please read the instructions and send the requested document.

name_mismatch.label: The name doesn't match
name_mismatch.explanation: The name on the document is different from the name on your account. Please update your account name or send a document in your name.

selfie_mismatch.label: The selfie doesn't match
selfie_mismatch.explanation: We couldn't match your selfie with the photo on the document. Please take a new, well-lit selfie holding the document.

cadastral_mismatch.label: The cadastral code doesn't match
cadastral_mismatch.explanation: The cadastral code on the extract is different from the one on your listing. Please check both and send the correct extract.

suspected_forgery.label: The document couldn't be confirmed
suspected_forgery.explanation: We couldn't confirm that this document is genuine. Please contact support if you think this is a mistake.

other.label: Other
other.explanation: Please read the note from our team below.

overview.title: Overview
overview.greeting: Welcome back, {name}. Here is what needs attention today.
overview.noClicks: No contact clicks in the last 30 days.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every staff action and automatic safety step, newest first.
audit.emptyDescription: Try other filters or a wider date range.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.description: Check new and reported listings before they reach visitors.

in_review.title: The queue is empty
in_review.description: No listings are waiting for review. Nice work!

hidden.title: No hidden listings
hidden.description: Listings hidden automatically after several reports will appear here.

needs_changes.title: Nobody is waiting
needs_changes.description: Listings sent back to their owners for changes will appear here.

approved.title: Nothing approved lately
approved.description: Listings approved by a moderator in the last 14 days will appear here.

actions.notePlaceholder: Explain what to change, in simple words
actions.noteHint: The owner receives the reason in their language ({language}); the note is translated automatically.
actions.approveDescription: “{title}” goes live on the site and the owner gets an email.
actions.restoreDescription: The listing becomes visible again (or expired, if its time has run out).
actions.requestChangesDescription: The listing leaves the site until the owner fixes it and sends it again.
actions.rejectDescription: The listing can't be published. The owner gets the reason by email.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: What visitors reported about listings and accounts.
reports.emptyOpenDescription: When visitors report a listing or a profile, it will appear here.
reports.targetGone: The reported item no longer exists.
reports.restoreHint: Tip: resolve or dismiss the report first, so the listing isn't hidden again by the same reports.
reports.readOnly: You can view reports, but only moderators can act on them.
reports.reporterStats: {count, plural, one {{count} report sent} other {{count} reports sent}} · joined {age}
reports.otherReports: {count, plural, =0 {Other reports} one {{count} other report} other {{count} other reports}}
reports.noOtherReports: No other reports about this listing or account.

actions.resolveDescription: Write what was done, for the team. The reporter isn't notified.
actions.resolutionPlaceholder: e.g. Asked the owner to change the photos
actions.dismissDescription: Use this when the report is not a real problem.
actions.hideDescription: The listing leaves the site until a moderator restores it. The owner gets an email.
actions.restoreDescription: The listing becomes visible again on the site.
actions.warnDescription: The account is marked as warned and gets an email with the reason in their language.
actions.noteHint: Translated automatically into the user's language.

users.title: Users
users.description: Find accounts by name, phone, email, user ID or listing ID.
users.emptySearch: Check the spelling, or search by phone number or listing ID.
users.selfHint: This is your own account. Another staff member has to change it.

users.reportsMade: {count, plural, =0 {Reports sent} one {{count} report sent} other {{count} reports sent}}

users.devicesSummary: {devices} devices · {accounts} other accounts on the same devices

role.title: Role
role.label: Role
role.needsTwoFactor: Role changed. This person must turn on 2-step login before opening the admin panel.
role.twoFactorWarning: This person hasn't turned on 2-step login yet. They can't open the admin panel until they do.
role.hint: Only administrators can change roles. Staff who lose a role are signed out.

notes.title: Internal notes
notes.description: Only staff can see these notes.
notes.label: New note
notes.placeholder: Write a note for the team…

actions.noteHint: Sent by email in the user's language (translated automatically).
actions.verifyDescription: Only do this after you checked the ID of {name} yourself. Your name is recorded.
actions.verified: The ID is marked as verified.
actions.warnDescription: The account is marked as warned and gets an email with the reason.
actions.suspendDescription: The person is signed out everywhere and can't sign in until the date you choose. They get an email.
actions.banDescription: The person is signed out everywhere and can't sign in again. Their live listings are taken off the site.
actions.listingsPaused: {count, plural, one {{count} listing was taken off the site.} other {{count} listings were taken off the site.}}
actions.reactivateDescription: The account becomes active again. Paused listings stay paused until the owner turns them on.

verifications.noDocuments: No documents were uploaded with this request.
